title: Unit Event — Friendship Rebuilt — Episode7 Unfading Bonds

meta.Event Outline: In the wake of iHaz, MORE MORE JUMP! are inundated with work offers. After taking a fresh look at their schedule, Airi and the rest of MMJ consider adopting a work style that makes use of the credit-based course.

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That really happened...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, how are things between you, Ayumi and the others now...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
We're still friends.
We still greet each other when we pass by in the corridor and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I don't really get messages from her anymore. We haven't spoken in so long...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I don't think there's anything I could've done about all that. At the same time, it still hurts to think about it...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's why I'm afraid that Minori's also going to start drifting away from her friends...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Of course, I'm not saying that's the only possible outcome. I mean, I still hang out with some of my friends from junior high...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's just... I can't help but feel worried...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm actually not so sure...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, I agree that being a busy idol means not being able to spend as much time with your friends...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: However, I doubt the bonds you forged with them would disappear because of that...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh... You think so...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I believe that the bonds friends establish are no different from one's feelings.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Our feelings...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. When people form relationships, they always do so by developing some manner of feelings for one another...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What those feelings are depends on their situation... For example, two friends may want to be kind to each other...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Once those feelings have been firmly established, it seems unlikely that they'll fade easily, even if you were to wish to get rid of them.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Just like your own feelings...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: They don't fade...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. I take it you two know what I mean?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The desire to spread hope to others as idols. That feeling never left us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're right. Even though I once thought it faded away completely.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: See? That's why I believe the bonds you forged with your friends are just as stubborn.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Just as you still possess feelings for them, Airi, I'm sure they also still feel the same way about you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I have a hard time believing that such bonds would break so easily.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi, I agree with what he's saying.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Because how wonderful would it be if you found a way to rekindle the friendships with the people you've become estranged from after all these years...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Also, even if something were to happen that meant you and I ended up drifting apart...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sure that the warm kindness I sense in you would never really go away.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Even if I were to forget all about it, I know I'd remember in time. So, I think things are going to turn out just fine...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Just like our feelings, the bonds we've forged never really fade or break...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I wanna believe that too...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
KAITO, everyone, thanks for listening to my story.
I'll take what I just learned and try thinking about this some more.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
And good luck, Airi.
The next day - Lunch break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: See? That's why I believe the bonds you forged with your friends are just as stubborn.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Just as you still possess feelings for them, Airi, I'm sure they also still feel the same way about you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I have a hard time believing that such bonds would break so easily.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(Yeah, I'm sure he's right.
Those kinds of feelings don't just disappear...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(I mean, just look at me...
I still feel awful about what happened with Ayumi.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (There's no way I'd be filled with so much regret if those feelings were gone from within me.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Still, if that's the case...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Is it okay for me to see for sure...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(If there is a way for me to check...
Would that change things?)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Would it be like old times...?
Then, I'll be waiting in the courtyard! Don't take too long with whatever the teacher asked you to do, okay?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Isn't that Ayumi...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Here? Now? But why...? What are the odds...?)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(No, we go to the same school...
It's completely normal for us to spot each other from time to time.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I have a hard time believing that such bonds would break so easily.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Because how wonderful would it be if you found a way to rekindle the friendships with the people you've become estranged from after all these years...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Also, even if something were to happen that meant you and I ended up drifting apart...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sure that the warm kindness I sense in you would never really go away.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Even if I were to forget all about it, I know I'd remember in time. So, I think things are going to turn out just fine...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: *Wince*

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: A-Ayumi...!

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: A-Airi...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Umm... Long time no see. How have you been?

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: Oh, um... Yeah, it's been a while...

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: But... What's gotten into you all of a sudden?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, um... I, well...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I called her name without really thinking... What am I supposed to talk about with her...?)

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: Airi...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I... I was just wondering how you've been doing lately...

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line:
How I've been doing...?
You know, the same old, same old...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, okay... Sorry for asking you out of the blue...

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: No, that's okay.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(What do I do...?
I don't know what to say next...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Does this mean things are never gonna be like old times...?)

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line:
Um, so... Airi, how have you been?
I know you've been really busy lately. Are you holding up okay?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: I watch your streams from time to time. Everyone's been talking about MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You've been watching...?

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line:
Yeah, my friends told me about them.
You always look like you're having so much fun, Airi, and it really puts a smile on my face...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
R-Really...?
Thanks. I'm so happy to hear that.

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: Of course! Also, I'm really glad for you...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: Remember how you took a break from being an idol? I was so worried for you then.

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line:
But I guess that's too little, too late...
I really couldn't do anything for you back then.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No, that's not true... But...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You were that worried...?

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: Yeah. I mean, we're friends, aren't we?

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: But that also sounds like just words... Before I knew it, we sort of stopped talking to each other...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah... A gap began to slowly form between us after that field trip...

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I didn't want to feel like a bother to you...

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: But that led to talking to you less and less, which only caused us to drift apart more and more... Eventually, I felt awkward even just trying to start a conversation with you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I didn't mean for any of that to happen...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You were never a bother...
I was afraid of disappointing you by making promises I couldn't keep. It's my fault for not being more honest...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Even back then, I kept wishing that I could hang out with you and the others more...

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: You did...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. All the messages you sent me gave me a lot of encouragement too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
But I never told you just how much that meant to me.
I'm really sorry, Ayumi...

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: No, please... You don't need to apologize.

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: I mean, Airi, you're here talking to me again, aren't you?

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: Because you decided to come over, we're having a real conversation now.

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: You worked up the courage to do what I was too scared to...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ayumi...

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: I've been wanting to talk with you forever too, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: We don't have to eat lunch or hang out together like we used to. I just want to stay friends with you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I feel the same way...

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: Really? Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line:
Um...
Would it be okay if I started messaging you again?

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: I know we won't be able to hang out much and that I might be interfering with your work...

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: But I want to go back to having a real friendship with you, Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Of course! Message me all you want!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It might take me a while to respond, but I promise to always get back to you...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And let's hang out again sometime.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Like old times...

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (What happened? This feels so weird.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Just a second ago, I thought none of this would be possible...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I didn't think it'd be this easy to see if there was anything left of our old friendship. But all I had to do was talk to her...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
So, Airi, did that happen to you...?
Did you and your classmates become more and more distant because you were credit-based...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (How would I respond now if Minori were to ask me the same question...?)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Yes, there's going to be some distance or awkwardness between you and your friends if you go credit-based...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But that doesn't mean all your relationships are gonna unravel or fall apart.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Just don't give up... Believe in the bonds that you and your friends forged...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (All you need to do is work up a little courage and tell them how you really feel...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Then, you'll get to keep being friends...)
